[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 16th August, 2011]
No. PAB/Legis: V
(07)/2011/1719, dated 16-8-2011.---The Balochistan Prisons (Amendment) Bill
No.7 of 2011, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on
11th August, 2011 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan on 13th August,
2011 is hereby published as an Act of the Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas, it is expedient further to amend the
Prisons Act, 1894 (Act No. XI of 1894), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Prisons (Balochistan
Amendment) Act, 2011.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

Amendment of section 30 Act XI of 1894

ACT VII OF 2011
PRISONS (BALOCHISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011
An Act further to amend the
Prisons Act, 1894
(Act XI of 1894)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 16th August, 2011]
No. PAB/Legis: V
(07)/2011/1719, dated 16-8-2011.---The Balochistan Prisons (Amendment) Bill
No.7 of 2011, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on
11th August, 2011 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan on 13th August,
2011 is hereby published as an Act of the Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas, it is expedient further to amend the
Prisons Act, 1894 (Act No. XI of 1894), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment of
section 30 Act XI of 1894.---In
the Prisons Act 1894 (Act No. XI of 1894), in Section 30,----
(a) in subsection
(1), the words "immediately on his arrival in the prison after sentence
" shall be omitted: and
(b) for subsection
(2) the following shall be substituted, namely:-
"(2) Every
such prisoner whose death sentence awarded by trial court has been confirmed
under section 376 of Criminal Procedure Code 1898 and it becomes executable,
shall be confined in a cell apart from
all other prisoners, and shall be placed by day and by night under the charge
of a guard.
(c) after
subsection (2), amended as aforesaid, the following new subsection shall be
added, namely:--
"(3) The
prisoners who are sentenced to death by the trial court shall not be treated as
condemned prisoners and shall not be confined in deathcells by day and night,
until the time their appeal is dismissed and/ or the sentence of death is
confirmed by the High Court or Federal Shariat Court, as the case may be.
